description: A nen technique based on rock-paper-scissors, channeling Enhancer, Emitter, or Conjurer energy through each hand sign.
Converts nen into electricity, allowing movement and attacks at lightning speed beyond the range of conscious thought.
A Specialist ability that activates all six nen types at 100% efficiency, at the cost of one hour of life per second active.
An Emitter technique that opens a portal through which the user can strike distant targets as if they were right in front of them.
A Transmutation ability that gives the user's nen the properties of both rubber and gum, allowing it to stretch, stick, and snap back.
A Specialist ability that allows the user to steal others' nen abilities and store them in a conjured book.
A Manipulation ability that uses special needles inserted into the head to control other people's bodies remotely.
A Specialist ability that allows the user to absorb the nen of others they consume, taking on their abilities and growing exponentially stronger.
A Specialist ability that manifests a giant doctor-like puppet capable of performing complex surgeries to repair any injury.
A Manipulation ability that allows the user to break down into countless microscopic butterfly scales to read others' emotions through aura fluctuations.
A Transmutation ability that converts the user's rage into pure nen energy, allowing them to reshape their body and aura into any form.
A Transmutation ability that converts the user's endured pain into a superheated energy attack proportional to the damage received.
A Transmutation ability that creates nen threads strong enough to reattach severed limbs or restrain enemies.
A Manipulation ability that uses antennas to take full control of a person's body and nervous system via a mobile phone.
A Specialist ability that allows the user to read a person's memories through physical contact, and share those memories as bullets.
An Enhancer ability that multiplies attack power based on the number of arm rotations performed before the strike.
A Conjurer ability that summons a vacuum devil that can suck up anything that is not alive, with no limit to storage.
A Conjurer ability that creates perfect physical copies of any non-living object the user touches with their left hand.
An Enhancer ability that concentrates all nen into a single punch, generating an explosion with the force of a small bomb.
A Transmutation ability that uses nen to give therapeutic massages, rapidly restoring a person's aura and physical condition.
An Emitter ability that uses a giant smokestack pipe to create nen-infused smoke soldiers that can follow complex commands.
An Emitter ability that creates pocket dimensions as doorways, allowing instant teleportation between any two marked points.
An Emitter ability that lends nen to opponents with interest, and when the debt exceeds their capacity, they are rendered unable to use nen.
A Manipulation ability that traps objects or body parts inside floating cages, immobilizing them in mid-air.
A Conjurer ability that summons a random weapon from a numbered wheel, with one slot containing a scythe powerful enough to split the ground.
A Specialist ability that produces divinely inspired poetry foretelling a target's future, providing accurate prophecies of up to four people at a time.
A powerful Hatsu that conjures a colossal multi-armed Bodhisattva statue capable of delivering hundreds of devastating palm strikes at superhuman speed.
A Transmutation ability that shapes aura into a massive dragon, which can then rain down dozens of smaller piercing dragons over a wide target area.
An Emitter ability that creates highly compressed nen balls with devastating force, capable of obliterating anything they touch.
A Conjurer ability that attaches a Nen bomb to a target after revealing the ability's rules; the bomb detonates when a specific keyword phrase is uttered.
A Transmutation ability that channels aura through shinobi conditioning to supercharge physical attributes, allowing speed and strength that appear superhuman to ordinary observers.
An Emission ability that shapes aura between two fingers into a bowstring and fires colored arrow projectiles, each color carrying a distinct elemental property.
A Manipulation ability that directs a colony of trained bees stored in her hat to attack, scout, and deliver messages; if she is knocked unconscious they attack indiscriminately.
An Enhancement ability that infuses gold coins with Shu and fires them simultaneously from both hands at ultrasonic speed, each coin hitting with more force than a gunshot.
An Enhancement ability that spins the user on a prosthetic peg leg while charging the body and handheld tops with aura, turning the user into a living spinning weapon.
An Emission ability that channels high-voltage electrical aura through twin bullwhips, delivering powerful shocks to anyone struck and creating an aura barrier when spun defensively.
A Manipulation ability that manifests a phantom limb of aura in place of the user's severed arm, capable of stretching to grip and hold opponents from a distance.
An Emission ability that fires concentrated aura bullets simultaneously from all ten fingers at ultrasonic speed, each shot carrying destructive force capable of mowing down groups of enemies.

A Manipulation ability that scatters paper confetti and guides the shards to pierce a target repeatedly from multiple angles, and can attach a shard to a person to function as an audio surveillance device.

A Manipulation ability that plays Nen-infused flute music to heal injuries, calm aura, and stabilize emotions in listeners; she can also passively detect lies by hearing the slightest irregularities in heartbeat.
A Manipulation ability that uses Nen to command a pack of trained dogs, directing them to perform reconnaissance, attack targets, and deliver coded signals via bark patterns.
A Manipulation ability activated by a kiss that immediately converts the target into a fully obedient slave; the effect persists until the user consciously releases it.
A Conjurer ability that infuses composed haiku verse with Nen, causing the literal content of each poem to manifest as a real physical phenomenon such as flames, lightning, or storms.
A Conjurer ability that summons a Nen beast specifically designed to consume a targeted Nen curse; the beast then binds to Abengane until the formerly cursed person dies naturally.
An Emission ability that concentrates aura into a single fingertip and releases it on contact as a small but devastatingly powerful explosion.
An Emission ability that concentrates aura into a single fingertip and releases it on contact as a small but devastatingly powerful explosion.
An unconscious Enhancement of cognitive ability that pushes her brain beyond human limits when playing Gungi, allowing her to intuitively devise strategies that no Nen user has ever defeated.
A Specialist ability that draws Nen curses into her own body to break them down and dissolve them; she is the only known Chimera Ant with exorcism-type capabilities.
A Conjurer ability that transforms the user's body into a functional vehicle — motorcycle, glider, or similar — powered by the aura supplied by whoever rides her.
A Nen ability that deploys three phantom monkeys — one each for sight, hearing, and speech — that blinds, deafens, and silences any target they successfully strike.
